source.label: Wikipedia: Nainsukh “was an important practitioner of Pahari painting”

bio.text: He was the younger son of the painter Pandit Seu and, like his older brother Manaku of Guler, was an important practitioner of Pahari painting, and has been called "one of the most original and brilliant of Indian painters".

Devices and mannerisms associated with Nainsukh include: a preference for uncoloured grounds; shading through a light wash that imparts volume and weight to figures and groups; a fine horizontal line that separates ground from background; a rich green in which his landscapes are usually bathed
For the first time, we see an Indian artist throwing himself into his work, and speaking through it with the most unassuming engagement with his themes, subjects and self.

source.author: Amit Dutta
